news.title: Max Estates pre-sales rise to ₹3,200 crore in H1 FY27
news.para: Max Estates reported pre-sales of about ₹3,200 crore in H1 FY27, including ₹2,100 crore in the September quarter. The company has a development pipeline with potential GDV of over ₹29,000 crore and plans major launches in Noida and Gurugram during H2 FY27.

news.title: Vishal Dadlani sells commercial unit in Mumbai for ₹3.34 crore
news.para: Singer and music composer Vishal Dadlani has sold a 641 sq ft commercial unit in Goregaon West, Mumbai, for ₹3.34 crore, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards. He had purchased the property in 2016 for ₹3.25 crore.

news.title: Rehabilitation township to be ready by Oct-end: Kerala agriculture minister
news.para: Agriculture minister T Siddique declared that the reconstruction of homes for the landslide survivors in Kalpetta will be accomplished by the end of October. With 177 out of 178 residences currently occupied, plans are also in place for essential facilities such as a health center and playground to be completed by November.

news.title: Narol residents move Gujarat high court against eviction order
news.para: Thirty-four residents of Jagdish Row Houses have taken their dispute to the Gujarat High Court over a contested eviction order from the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation. Facing a seven-day deadline to vacate, the residents—comprising mainly labourers and seniors—assert their ownership of properties, supported by tax and utility documentation. They emphasize that their personal objections were overlooked in the eviction decision.

news.title: NCR housing sales fall 11% to 35,574 units in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Housing sales in NCR declined 11% year-on-year to 35,574 units during January-September 2026, with the slowdown concentrated in Gurugram and the ₹5-10 crore segment. Sales outside Gurugram, however, rose 3%, while the ₹2-5 crore segment recorded 8% growth.

news.title: WeWork India adds 2.25 lakh sq ft across Bengaluru, Pune; opens two centres
news.para: WeWork India Management has expanded its footprint by launching new flexible workspace centers in Bengaluru and Pune, significantly increasing available desk capacity. The WeWork Infinix Palladium in Whitefield offers over 3,100 desks across approximately 1.7 lakh sq ft, while the WeWork Millennium Towers in Wakad provides around 1,400 desks in a 55,000 sq ft space. By Q1 FY27, WeWork India continues to enhance its presence in the flexible workspace sector.

news.title: Prayagraj plans to build 1,200 government flats in Naini, Jhunsi amid housing shortage
news.para: In an effort to combat the shortage of government housing, Prayagraj is launching a project to construct new accommodations specifically for its employees. This initiative will provide around 1,200 flats in Naini and Jhunsi, alleviating the reliance on rented properties and reducing long commutes to work. Currently, relevant departments are assessing government land available for this development and securing necessary approvals.

news.title: Uttarakhand CM announces land, housing measures for Banbasa, Tanakpur
news.para: Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami has unveiled a series of initiatives focused on enhancing housing, education, and the beautification of religious sites. These initiatives are tailored to assist families residing in temporary accommodations within urban zones. Plans are also set to significantly expand the APJ Abdul Kalam Government Engineering College in Tanakpur.

news.title: PMC cracks down on illegal construction waste dumping across Pune
news.para: The Pune municipal corporation has taken decisive action against illegal construction waste dumping, imposing significant penalties. To combat this issue, officials have created facilities dedicated to recycling construction and demolition debris. With the city generating around 250 metric tonnes daily, effective monitoring is crucial. Community members suggest cash incentives for reporting violations, and a toll-free helpline has been introduced to streamline waste management assistance.

news.title: Four commercial properties sealed in Gurugram for tax dues over ₹1 crore
news.para: The MCG enforcement team took decisive action by sealing four commercial properties in Gurgaon due to non-payment of property taxes, totaling Rs 1.5 crore. With two properties in Sector 16 responsible for Rs 121.2 lakh and two in Sector 61 each exceeding Rs 15 lakh, the MCG has revealed that it raised over Rs 350 crore in property taxes for the financial year 2025-26.

news.title: West Bengal introduces 100% waiver on property tax dues in six civic bodies
news.para: The West Bengal government has rolled out property tax waiver initiatives targeting defaulters across six municipal corporations. Active until March 31, these programs promise substantial cuts in penalties and interest. Homeowners have a chance to clear outstanding dues at reduced rates, potentially boosting local revenue. Notably, the Howrah Municipal Corporation has issued a tailored notification for its taxpayers.

news.title: Over 60 lakh properties in Bengaluru, but only 18 lakh owners pay tax: Development minister
news.para: Bengaluru's property tax challenge stems from low compliance, as around 18 lakh properties are actively paying taxes. Officials estimate the total number of properties in the city may be between 47 lakh and 62 lakh. Many property owners reportedly under-report their tax liabilities while using civic services. The government is focusing on improving compliance rather than raising tax rates to address these financial issues.

news.title: Telengana readies sweeping land pooling policy for infrastructure projects
news.para: The Telangana government plans to roll out a novel land pooling policy designed for infrastructure advancements throughout the state. Instead of receiving monetary compensation, landowners will be rewarded with developed plots when their land is acquired. Initiatives for projects like the Musi riverfront are already in progress, aiming to lower land acquisition expenses.

news.title: Notice to 500 homeowners in HSVP sectors in Gurugram for building code violations
news.para: Haryana Shehri Vikas Pradhikaran has launched a crackdown on homeowners misusing residential spaces for business purposes. Approximately 500 property owners have been notified for various breaches. With an increased focus on compliance, estate offices are conducting detailed surveys. Homeowners will have the chance to respond, yet failure to correct these violations may lead to disconnections of services or reclaiming of properties by the authorities.

news.title: FIR against Ghaziabad's RKS Buildcon India for handing over flats without CC
news.para: RKS Buildcon India stands accused of illegally transferring home possession without a requisite completion certificate, leading to the Ghaziabad Development Authority filing an FIR against the builder. This case opens the door for over 100 developers to face potential legal actions due to widespread non-compliance within the region. Even with regulations in place, a number of developers persist in unlawful deliveries, causing the GDA to initiate reporting for further action.

news.title: US Supreme Court won't hear Zillow's bid to escape investor class action
news.para: Recently, the US Supreme Court decided against hearing Zillow Group's appeal linked to a class action lawsuit, which alleges that the company provided misleading information to investors about its failed home-flipping endeavor. Investors contend that Zillow's overly optimistic statements resulted in significant financial damage when the division was shut down.

news.title: Runwal Enterprises shares make muted market debut; end nearly 2% lower
news.para: Runwal Enterprises Ltd experienced a tepid debut as its shares were listed on the market. Opening slightly above the issue price, the stock ended lower by day's close, fluctuating throughout the intraday session. With a notably oversubscribed IPO, investor interest was strong, and the funds raised will be allocated towards debt repayment and upcoming projects.

news.title: Raymond Realty pre-sales rise 98% to ₹902 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Raymond Realty reported pre-sales of ₹902 crore in Q2 FY27, up 98% year-on-year, while collections increased 67% to ₹682 crore. For H1 FY27, pre-sales rose 111% to ₹1,602 crore and collections increased 57% to ₹1,233 crore.

news.title: South Bengaluru. Experience the finer way of living
news.para: Shriram Properties Ltd is making significant strides in Bengaluru’s southern corridor by developing residential projects that emphasize community living. With 52 projects already delivered and plans for 41 more, the area is witnessing a surge in residential demand. Enhanced connectivity via NICE Road, alongside a strong educational infrastructure, attracts families and professionals alike. Anticipated future developments, including a new airport, are poised to further elevate the region's appeal.
